fullDescription: Welcome to this beautifully updated 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home, offering a wonderful combination of classic character and modern comfort in the desirable Pico-Robertson neighborhood. Thoughtful details throughout include original built-in storage, updated light fixtures, generous bedroom closets, and a lovely alcove off the living room. Conveniently located in Pico-Robertson, near shopping, dining, and neighborhood amenities. Schedule a tour today and discover everything this charming home has to offer!
